339 AM CDT Fri Oct 16 2026 /439 AM EDT Fri Oct 16 2026/

This Hazardous Weather Outlook is for portions of central
Illinois, east central Illinois, north central Illinois,
northeast Illinois, and northwest Indiana.

.DAY ONE...Today and Tonight

Northwest wind gusts over 30 mph are expected this afternoon with
a few gusts to around 45 mph along the Indiana Lake Michigan
shore this afternoon into early this evening. 

Frost and freeze conditions are expected late tonight across
portions of interior northern Illinois, especially near and north
of I-80. 

.DAYS TWO THROUGH SEVEN...Saturday through Thursday

Frost and freeze conditions are likely again Saturday night into
early Sunday morning, especially across northwest Indiana.

This Hazardous Weather Outlook is for portions of Lake Michigan.

.DAY ONE...Today and Tonight

Gale force winds are likely this afternoon and evening. 

Waterspouts and isolated thunderstorms are possible this afternoon
into this evening, mainly Indiana waters east of Gary. 

.DAYS TWO THROUGH SEVEN...Saturday through Thursday

Hazardous conditions for small craft are expected Saturday.
